attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Florida state income tax calculation. FL has no state income tax - this table simply sets state_tax_liability to 0.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.fl_tax = 0; add " Florida (no state income tax)" to job.audit_trail
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: 0 cvi /result.fl_tax xdef " Florida (no state income tax)" job.audit_trail swap addto
initial_action.action_postfix: 0 /result.fl_tax xdef " FL has no state income tax: $0" job.audit_trail swap addto
